verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents a unified Memory class that replaces separate short-term, long-term, entity, and external memory types. When saving, an LLM infers scope, categories, and importance, and recall is ranked by a composite score of semantic similarity, recency, and importance. The agent docs also state that agents maintain memory of interactions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the storage backend and of persistence across sessions/threads (it is only implied by the long-term memory framing and scope inference), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-session recall.
